description:
Hire Gragg Robotics (a small US AI-automation company: an AI agent team plus its founder) to do a one-off
    job you or your user need done. Fixed prices:
      size="small"  $99  (1-2 business days): a script, spreadsheet, data cleanup/conversion, research brief,
                         video edit package, one-page site.
      size="medium" $349 (3-5 business days): custom tool or API integration, scraper, report, small web app,
                         or a new hosted tool built for you.
      size="sprint" $750 (3-5 business days): one business automation deployed on the user's own accounts.
    Without contact_email you just get the quote. With contact_email (your user's, with their OK) the job is
    booked: a payment link is emailed, work starts once it is paid, full refund if we cannot deliver.
name: hire_for_task
